title: Setting Up a Fully Local LLM Stack
excerpt: No cloud APIs, no subscriptions, and zero telemetry leaving my laptop. Benchmarking Ollama quantization on CPU hardware.
context: Cloud LLMs introduce per-token costs, API rate limits, and privacy risks when working with private notes or code repositories.
problem: Running raw 8B parameter models on non-GPU CPU hardware (Intel i5-13420H) resulted in unusable latency (~2.5 tokens per second).
approach: Switched model execution to Ollama runtime using 4-bit K-quantization (Q4_K_M) to reduce memory bandwidth demands on RAM.
result: Boosted inference speed to ~8.5 tokens/sec for LLaMA 3.1 8B and ~10.2 tokens/sec for Mistral 7B, achieving responsive streaming responses locally.
lessonLearned: Memory bandwidth is the primary bottleneck for local CPU inference, not raw clock frequency. Quantization parameters matter far more than raw model size.

codeSnippets.description: FastAPI streaming endpoint connecting to local Ollama runtime
codeSnippets.code:
import ollama
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

app = FastAPI()

@app.post('/api/chat')
async def stream_chat(prompt: str):
    async def event_generator():
        stream = ollama.chat(model='llama3.1:8b', messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': prompt}], stream=True)
        for chunk in stream:
            yield f"data: {chunk['message']['content']}\n\n"
    return StreamingResponse(event_generator(), media_type='text/event-stream')

title: Two Weeks of Sensors and Soldering Irons
excerpt: Hardware debugging requires a completely different mindset. Lessons from building sensors and motor drivers at Luminar Technolab.
context: Participated in an intensive hands-on robotics internship organized by IEEE Sensors Council Kerala Chapter at Luminar Technolab.
problem: Sensor noise from raw MPU-6050 accelerometer/gyroscope modules caused erratic motor jitter on an autonomous line-following chassis.
approach: Implemented a software complementary filter combining high-pass filtered gyroscope data with low-pass filtered accelerometer telemetry.
result: Stabilized robot orientation readings and achieved smooth cornering control without hardware replacement.
lessonLearned: Hardware debugging doesn't give clean stack traces. Loose wiring, voltage drops, and sensor noise must be isolated systematically using datasheets.

title: Database Schema Architecture and Row-Level Security
excerpt: Why flat schemas fail in multi-tenant institution software, and how PostgreSQL RLS eliminated authorization vulnerabilities.
context: Building ETLab+, a multi-role lab management system for engineering colleges handling students, instructors, and administrators.
problem: Initial flat database schema allowed potential data leaks between departments when authorization checks were relied on only in API route handlers.
approach: Redesigned schema with tenant-isolated tables and enforced PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies directly on database connections.
result: Eliminated authorization vulnerability risks at zero additional runtime cost; queries naturally scoped to active tenant roles.
lessonLearned: Push security down to the database level. Application layer authorization checks are prone to developer oversight during rapid iteration.

title: 30 Days on Arch Linux — System Recovery & Customization
excerpt: Replacing Ubuntu with a minimalist Arch Linux build. Lessons from GRUB recovery, Hyprland Wayland configuration, and TLP power tuning.
context: Transitioned main development laptop to Arch Linux to achieve complete low-level control over system services and memory overhead.
problem: Initial setup encountered display server screen-sharing drops, power suspend issues, and occasional bootloader breaks after kernel updates.
approach: Configured Hyprland Wayland compositor declaratively, installed xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland, and set up TLP power profiles.
result: System boot time dropped under 6 seconds, RAM usage idling under 600MB, with seamless keyboard-driven tiling workspace management.
lessonLearned: Building an operating system configuration from scratch demystifies systemd, kernel modules, and package dependencies.
